facts.business: Benchmark Computer Solutions Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in computer solutions and related services.
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during the financial year ended March 31, 2026 were on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions were made with Promoters, Directors, or other designated persons that may have a potential conflict with the interest of the Company. Disclosure in Form AOC-2 is not required. Transactions with related parties as per Accounting Standard-18 are given in Note 33 to the Balance Sheet as on March 31, 2026.
